lines: Laughter and the smell of fresh bread spill out of the {Brightwater Inn}.
A loom clacks steadily inside. A note pinned to the door reads: {Back after supper}.
The door is latched. Somewhere inside, a kettle begins to sing.
Flour dust on the doorstep and bread cooling on the sill. The miller is out chasing the wind.
Muddy boots by the door, and a chalk sign: {Fresh eggs — ask Tamsin}.
The water is clear and cold. Far below, a copper coin glints.
You make a small wish of your own.

text.speaker: Signpost
lines: Someone has added, in smaller letters: "Mind the chickens. They bite."

text.speaker: Signpost
lines: {Miller's Hill}. On a clear evening you can watch the falls turn gold from here.

objects.name: Elda
dialogue: Welcome to {Brightwater Crossing}, traveler! The river has carried folk past our door for a hundred years.
Most of them stay for supper. A few stay for good.
Climb the stairs to {Miller's Hill} at sunset — the falls turn to gold.

objects.name: Marigold
dialogue: Welcome to the {Brightwater Inn}! Soft beds, hot stew, and the river to sing you to sleep.

objects.name: Posy
dialogue: Honey buns! Still warm from the oven, and sweet as a summer evening.

objects.name: Tamsin
dialogue: The hens have been laying like mad since the lantern festival.
If you see one wandering off toward the river, give her a gentle nudge home, would you?
